name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Father's Vengeance) — 1 Basic — Zillah's Litany

system.description:
Reciting the passages of Zillah, first bride bound to Caine, the thaumaturge glimpses the invisible threads of blood that tie their target to others.

This power affects only Cainites, and you must speak the relevant passages aloud to your target. Make a Simple Test for each vampire to whom your subject is bound by blood bond or Vinculum: on a tie you gain a hazy impression of that individual's face, and on a win you gain their face, the name by which the subject knows them, and a hazy psychic impression. A Narrator often arbitrates, since your subject may not be aware of all their own Vinculi. Retest with Occult.
